world_metadata.name: Valorheim
world_metadata.background_lore: An ancient kingdom built atop the forgotten ruins of a civilization that worshipped entropy. The Crimson Covenant seeks to break the seals keeping the Shadow Vessel dormant.

ambiance_echoes: A cold wind rustles the leaves, carrying the faint scent of woodsmoke.
Somewhere in the distance, a dog barks, abruptly silenced.
The shadows seem to stretch a little further than they should.

weather_states.clear: The sky is a pale, crisp blue, though the sun offers little warmth.
weather_states.rain: A cold, driving rain turns the dirt roads into thick mud.
weather_states.fog: Unnatural, thick gray fog rolls in, reducing visibility to mere feet.

ambiance_echoes: The heavy tolling of the palace bells echoes through the stone streets.
A patrol of crimson-cloaked guards marches past, their boots striking in unison.
You feel a sudden, inexplicable drop in temperature. You are being watched.

weather_states.clear: Smog from the lower city districts partially obscures the midday sun.
weather_states.storm: Purple-tinged lightning arcs across the black clouds gathering above the palace.
weather_states.ash_fall: Flakes of gray ash drift down from the sky, a byproduct of the corrupted mines.

time_system.global_echo_dawn: The sun rises, casting long, pale rays across the kingdom.
time_system.global_echo_dusk: The sun dips below the horizon. The shadows lengthen and deepen.
